Scenario Based Learning : 

Problem : 
A company works with number of employees, all the works are dependents on the employees. Even if one of the employees resign the job immediately then assigned work will be not finished at the time, so delivery of the project to the clients will be delayed. Company planned to make solution for this, they want to know which employee may resign next. If they know previously, they can arrange alternative to avoid such problem. As an AI Engineer you must give Solution to this.
A) How will you achieve this in AI?
 We can solve this problem using Predective analytics and Machine Learning.
    1. Data Collection : Collect the historical employee data (demographics, performance, tenure, salary, promotions, work-life balance, etc.).
    2. Feature Engineering : Identify key factors influencing resignation (e.g., low salary hikes, long commute, poor manager feedback). and identyfy the target as "Will the employee resign or not(yes/No)?".
    3. Select the model to learn patterns , using Classification algorithms(Logistics Regression, Naives Bayes, KNN , SVM, Decision Tree and Random Forest ) as target is not numerical, learn the patterns by training data.
    4. Train the model to predict the probability of an employee resigning in the near future.
    5. Call Action : HR can use this predictions to arrange backup resource or provide retention incentives or redistribute workload.

B) Find out the 3 -Stage of Problem Identification
  Stage 1: Domain Selection : Machine Learning
    Stage 2: Learning Selection ,  Supervised Learning
    Stage 3 : Choose a Classification algorithm as data is categorical
C) Name the project : Employee Retention Prediction
D) Create the dummy Dataset.
EmployeeID,Age,Gender,Department,JobRole,EducationLevel,YearsAtCompany,YearsInCurrentRole,Salary,PerformanceRating,WorkLifeBalance,OverTime,TrainingHoursLastYear,JobSatisfaction,EnvironmentSatisfaction,LastPromotionYears,ManagerSatisfaction,AbsenteeismDays,Attrition
